description: This file defines the JiraService class which provides methods to interact with Jira via an MCP client process. It handles creating issues, transitioning issues, adding comments, and mapping internal task statuses to Jira workflow statuses. The file imports configuration from a relative module and uses subprocess to communicate with an external MCP client.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: Service wrapper that communicates with the MCP client process exposing Jira tools for issue creation, transition, and commenting.

methods.name: bool _is_enabled(self)
methods.description: Checks if Jira MCP integration is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _run_tool(self, tool_name: str, args: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Executes an MCP client command with a given tool name and arguments, handling JSON serialization/deserialization and errors.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_issue(self, *, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task")
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue with specified project key, summary, description, and issue type.

methods.name: bool transition_issue(self, *, issue_key: str, status_name: str)
methods.description: Transitions a Jira issue to a specified workflow status.

methods.name: bool add_comment(self, *, issue_key: str, comment: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specified Jira issue.

ctags.pattern: /^    def _run_tool(self, tool_name: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def add_comment(self, *, issue_key: str, comment: str) -> bool:$/

ctags.signature: (self, *, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task")
